meta.title: যা অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে
meta.description: একটি আয়ুর্বেদিক পণ্যের জন্য কোন বুদ্ধিবৃত্তিক সম্পদ এবং নিয়ন্ত্রক প্রশ্ন প্রযোজ্য এবং সেগুলি কীভাবে সংযুক্ত।

heading: আয়ুর্বেদের আইপি এবং নিয়ন্ত্রক প্রেক্ষাপট বোঝা
standfirst: একটি আয়ুর্বেদিক পণ্যের বিভিন্ন অংশ বিভিন্ন প্রশ্ন তোলে। এই পৃষ্ঠাটি কোনটি কী তা চিহ্নিত করে।

pending.title: এই পৃষ্ঠার কোনো কিছুই এখনও উৎস থেকে নেওয়া হয়নি
pending.body: কোনো নথি অন্তর্ভুক্ত করা হয়নি, তাই নীচের প্রতিটি বিবৃতি মুলতুবি হিসেবে চিহ্নিত।

distinction.heading: দুটি প্রশ্ন, এবং কেন সেগুলি সংযুক্ত
distinction.ipBody: আমি কীভাবে এতে অধিকার সুরক্ষিত বা বুঝতে পারি? এটি একচেটিয়াত্বের বিষয়।
distinction.regBody: এটি তৈরি, বিক্রি বা বিজ্ঞাপন দেওয়ার আগে আমাকে কী করতে হবে? এটি অনুমতির বিষয়।
distinction.couplingHeading: আয়ুর্বেদের জন্য, এগুলি দুবার করা একটিই প্রশ্ন
distinction.couplingBody: বেশিরভাগ শিল্প এগুলিকে আলাদাভাবে বিবেচনা করতে পারে। কিন্তু এখানে তা সম্ভব নয় কারণ নিয়ন্ত্রক শ্রেণিবিন্যাস নির্ধারণ করে কী আইপি পাওয়া সম্ভব।
distinction.matrixHeading: প্রতিটি পণ্যের শ্রেণি কী খোলে এবং বন্ধ করে

classical_generic.ip: গঠন নথিভুক্ত ঐতিহ্যবাহী জ্ঞান, তাই এটি দাবিযোগ্য নয়। ব্র্যান্ড, প্যাকেজিং উপলব্ধ রয়েছে।
classical_generic.regulatory: [BN] The classical route, resting on the authoritative texts the drug rules recognise.
classical_generic.abs: [BN] Duties can still attach to the biological resource used, whatever the formulation's status.

patent_proprietary.ip: আসলে কী পরিবর্তিত হয়েছে তা নিয়ে বিতর্ক হতে পারে। শাস্ত্রীয় ভিত্তি অবশিষ্টাংশের বিরুদ্ধে পূর্ববর্তী শিল্প হিসেবে থাকে।
patent_proprietary.regulatory: [BN] Licensed as a patent or proprietary medicine, with conditions of its own.
patent_proprietary.abs: [BN] Duties attach, and they begin to interact with anything you file.

new_non_classical_drug.ip: সর্বাধিক সুযোগ। একটি অভিনব প্রক্রিয়া বা সংমিশ্রণ যা আগে অজানা ছিল তা নিজস্ব যোগ্যতায় দাবি করা যেতে পারে।
new_non_classical_drug.regulatory: [BN] The new-drug route, which asks for evidence rather than textual authority.
new_non_classical_drug.abs: [BN] Duties attach, and disclosure of the biological source becomes part of the filing.

phytopharmaceutical.ip: পরিশোধিত বা প্রমিত ভগ্নাংশ সবচেয়ে বেশি পেটেন্টযোগ্য রূপ, কারণ এটি পুরো উদ্ভিদের প্রস্তুতি থেকে সবচেয়ে দূরবর্তী।
phytopharmaceutical.regulatory: [BN] A route of its own, with data requirements separate from both the classical and the new-drug paths.
phytopharmaceutical.abs: [BN] Duties attach; the resource is usually a named plant, which makes the trigger easy to identify and hard to avoid.

ayurveda_aahar.ip: [BN] Brand, packaging and design. A food cannot be claimed as a medicine, and the composition is rarely claimable.
ayurveda_aahar.regulatory: [BN] The food route, under the food authority rather than the drug regulator.
ayurveda_aahar.abs: [BN] Duties can attach to the resource. Being a food does not remove them.

cosmetic.ip: [BN] Brand, packaging and the design of the article. Composition claims are narrow.
cosmetic.regulatory: [BN] The cosmetic route, which turns on external use for appearance rather than therapeutic effect.
cosmetic.abs: [BN] Duties can attach to the resource, on the same basis as any other use.

rights.heading: অধিকারসমূহ, এক এক করে
rights.standfirst: এগুলির প্রতিটি একটি ভিন্ন প্রশ্নের উত্তর দেয়।

labels.inAyurveda: How it shows up in Ayurveda
labels.question: A question people actually ask

patents.title: পেটেন্ট
patents.protects: (পেটেন্ট) A new invention that is not obvious to someone skilled in the field, for a limited term, in exchange for disclosing how it works.
patents.inAyurveda: Rarely the formulation itself. More often a process, a delivery form, a purified fraction, or a specific combination that does something the individual ingredients were not already known to do.
patents.question: We reformulated a classical preparation — is there anything patentable in it?
patents.doesNot: It does not give you permission to sell: a granted patent and a manufacturing licence are separate and neither implies the other. It does not make a formulation new — documented traditional knowledge is prior art, and an aggregation of known properties is generally not an invention.
patents.jurisdiction: India, with separate filings in every other country you want protection in.

gi.title: ভৌগোলিক ইঙ্গিত
gi.protects: (ভৌগোলিক ইঙ্গিত) A name identifying goods as coming from a particular place, where a quality, reputation or characteristic is due to that origin.
gi.inAyurveda: Regional herbs and preparations whose character is tied to where they grow, or to how a locality has long made them.
gi.question: Our herb grows only in one district — does that qualify for a geographical indication?
gi.doesNot: It is not owned by one company. A GI is held for a class of producers meeting the specification, so it gives no exclusivity over competitors in the same region, and does not stop anyone outside it making a similar product under another name.
gi.jurisdiction: India. Protection elsewhere is separate and works differently from country to country.

trademarks.title: ট্রেডমার্ক
trademarks.protects: (ট্রেডমার্ক) A sign that tells a buyer who made the product.
trademarks.inAyurveda: Brand names for Ayurvedic, Siddha and Unani products, house marks, and the get-up of a pack.
trademarks.question: Can we register our brand name if it contains a classical formulation name?
trademarks.doesNot: It does not hand you a classical formulation name. A mark merely describing the product will struggle, and other manufacturers need the same classical name for the same preparation. Registration does not license a claim the advertising rules prohibit — mark and claim are judged separately.
trademarks.jurisdiction: India, with separate registration abroad or through an international filing system.

copyright.title: কপিরাইট
copyright.protects: (কপিরাইট) Original expression — text, images, artwork, software — not the ideas, facts or methods inside it.
copyright.inAyurveda: Course material, translations and commentaries, packaging artwork, photography, software. The classical texts are long out of copyright; a new translation or commentary is a new work with its own term.
copyright.question: Can we stop someone copying our training material?
copyright.doesNot: It does not protect a formulation, a process, or a treatment protocol. Someone may read your book and make your product.
copyright.jurisdiction: India, with protection in most other countries arising automatically under treaty rather than by registration.

designs.title: ডিজাইন
designs.protects: (ডিজাইন) How a manufactured article looks — its shape, configuration, pattern or ornament.
designs.inAyurveda: A bottle, a dispenser, a jar closure, the form of a pack.
designs.question: We designed a distinctive dispenser — can we protect the shape?
designs.doesNot: It does not protect how the article works, and it does not survive publication: showing the design before you apply can destroy the right you were about to register.
designs.jurisdiction: India, with separate filings or an international route abroad.

plantVariety.title: উদ্ভিদের জাতের অধিকার
plantVariety.protects: (উদ্ভিদের জাতের অধিকার) A new plant variety that is distinct from what exists, uniform within itself, and stable across generations.
plantVariety.inAyurveda: Cultivated varieties of medicinal plants developed for yield, potency, or hardiness.
plantVariety.question: We developed a cultivar of a medicinal plant — can we register it?
plantVariety.doesNot: It is not a patent on the plant, and it sits alongside farmers' rights rather than overriding them.
plantVariety.jurisdiction: India, under a regime of its own rather than under the patent system.

tradeSecrets.title: বাণিজ্য গোপনীয়তা
tradeSecrets.protects: (বাণিজ্য গোপনীয়তা) In India, no standalone statute. Confidential information is held through contract, employment terms and the general law rather than by any registration.
tradeSecrets.inAyurveda: Process know-how, sourcing relationships, standardisation methods — precisely the things a patent application would have to disclose.
tradeSecrets.question: Should we file a patent or keep the process confidential?
tradeSecrets.doesNot: It gives you nothing against independent discovery or reverse engineering, and it is in direct tension with two disclosure obligations: what a patent application must reveal, and what a regulatory dossier must contain.
tradeSecrets.jurisdiction: India — and the absence of a dedicated statute is itself the point, so this section states a gap rather than a regime.

tk.title: ঐতিহ্যবাহী জ্ঞান
tk.protects: (ঐতিহ্যবাহী জ্ঞান) It depends on whether the knowledge is codified in published texts or held by a community. These are different problems with different answers.
tk.inAyurveda: Codified knowledge in the authoritative texts is why many formulation patents fail: it is prior art, documented so it can be cited as such. Community-held knowledge raises a different question, about consent and about sharing what comes of it.
tk.question: Our formulation comes from a community's practice — what do we owe them?
tk.doesNot: Defensive protection stops others patenting what is already known. It gives you no exclusive right of your own, and does not substitute for the access and benefit-sharing duties below.
tk.jurisdiction: India, and internationally: a 2024 treaty addresses intellectual property, genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge, including what an applicant must disclose.

regulation.heading: বিক্রি করার আগে কী প্রয়োজন
regulation.standfirst: শ্রেণিবিন্যাস প্রথমে আসে, কারণ এটি নির্ধারণ করে কোনটি প্রযোজ্য।

classification.title: পণ্যের শ্রেণিবিন্যাস
classification.body: [পণ্যের শ্রেণিবিন্যাস] Everything downstream follows from what your product is: a classical preparation, a patent or proprietary medicine, a new non-classical drug, a phytopharmaceutical, a food, or a cosmetic. The classification is not a label you choose — it follows from the formulation, the claim you make, and how far you have moved from an authoritative text.
classification.watchFor: Businesses often decide their route first and describe the product to fit. That is the wrong way round, and it is expensive to unwind.

licence.title: উৎপাদন লাইসেন্স
licence.body: [উৎপাদন লাইসেন্স] Making an Ayurvedic drug for sale requires a licence from the state licensing authority, and the licence is specific to what you make and where you make it.
licence.watchFor: A licence covering classical preparations does not automatically cover a proprietary medicine. Changing the formulation can put you outside the licence you already hold.

gmp.title: উৎপাদন অনুশীলন (GMP)
gmp.body: [উৎপাদন অনুশীলন (GMP)] Good manufacturing practice requirements for these products cover premises, equipment, staff, water, in-process checks and record-keeping. They are a condition of the licence rather than an optional standard.
gmp.watchFor: Contract manufacturing does not transfer the obligation away from the brand owner.

quality.title: মান এবং ফার্মাকোপিয়াল মানদণ্ড
quality.body: [মান এবং ফার্মাকোপিয়াল মানদণ্ড] Published pharmacopoeial monographs set identity, purity and strength standards for many single drugs and formulations, and a formulary records recognised preparations.
quality.watchFor: Where a monograph exists, meeting it is the baseline, not a marketing claim. Where none exists, you must be able to say what standard you work to and why.

labelling.title: লেবেলিং
labelling.body: [লেবেলিং] What must appear on the pack is set by more than one regime at once: drug rules, packaged-commodity rules, and — if the product is a food — the food authority's labelling regulations.
labelling.watchFor: The regimes overlap rather than nest. Satisfying one does not mean you have satisfied another.

advertising.title: বিজ্ঞাপন এবং দাবি
advertising.body: [বিজ্ঞাপন এবং দাবি] Advertising of these products is restricted, and certain disease claims are prohibited outright rather than merely regulated. The restriction applies to the advertisement, not only to the label.
advertising.watchFor: A claim that is prohibited on a pack is generally prohibited in a social media post as well. Enforcement follows the claim, not the medium.

food.title: খাদ্য ও নিউট্রাসিউটিক্যাল পথ
food.body: [খাদ্য ও নিউট্রাসিউটিক্যাল পথ] A product intended as a food or supplement rather than a medicine falls under the food authority, which has its own category for Ayurveda-derived foods, its own approval process, and its own limits on what a claim may say.
food.watchFor: This route is often chosen to avoid drug licensing. It brings different obligations rather than fewer, and it narrows what you may claim the product does.

cosmetic.title: প্রসাধনী পথ
cosmetic.body: [প্রসাধনী পথ] A preparation applied externally for appearance rather than therapeutic effect is regulated as a cosmetic, with its own registration and labelling requirements.
cosmetic.watchFor: The boundary is the claim. The same cream is a cosmetic or a drug depending on what you say it does.

clinicalEvidence.title: নতুন ওষুধের প্রমাণ
clinicalEvidence.body: [নতুন ওষুধের প্রমাণ] A formulation outside the classical texts, or one making a new therapeutic claim, moves into territory where safety and effectiveness have to be shown rather than inferred from tradition.
clinicalEvidence.watchFor: Traditional use can support some routes and not others. Which one you are on decides whether it counts.

marketAccess.title: আমদানি, রপ্তানি এবং বাজারে প্রবেশ
marketAccess.body: [আমদানি, রপ্তানি এবং বাজারে প্রবেশ] An Indian licence carries no weight abroad. Each destination decides for itself whether your product is a medicine, a supplement, a food or a novel ingredient, and answers that question by its own rules.
marketAccess.watchFor: The most common surprise is that the product changes category at the border, and with it the entire compliance burden.

abs.heading: প্রবেশাধিকার এবং সুবিধা ভাগাভাগি
abs.standfirst: এটি সেই বাধ্যবাধকতা যা প্রায়শই দেরিতে আবিষ্কৃত হয়।
abs.whoBody: আপনি কে তার ওপর নির্ভর করে বাধ্যবাধকতা পরিবর্তিত হয়। ভারতীয় ব্যক্তি, সংস্থা এবং বিদেশী সত্ত্বা আলাদাভাবে বিবেচিত হয়।
abs.triggerBody: গবেষণা বা বাণিজ্যিক ব্যবহারের জন্য কোনো জৈবিক সম্পদ বা সংশ্লিষ্ট জ্ঞান ব্যবহার করা এর সূচনা করে।
abs.authorityBody: জাতীয় কর্তৃপক্ষ (NBA) এবং রাজ্য জীববৈচিত্র্য পর্ষদ (SBB) রয়েছে।
abs.sharingBody: সুবিধা ভাগাভাগি সর্বদা কেবল আর্থিক অর্থপ্রদান নয়; এটি প্রযুক্তি হস্তান্তর বা স্থানীয় কর্মসংস্থানও হতে পারে।
abs.patentBody: জৈবিক সম্পদ ভিত্তিক পেটেন্ট আবেদনে উৎসের বিবরণ প্রকাশ করা বাধ্যতামূলক।
abs.changeBody: ভারতীয় জীববৈচিত্র্য আইনের সাম্প্রতিক বছরগুলিতে সংশোধন করা হয়েছে।
abs.asOfNote: এই কর্পাস সংস্করণ {{version}} এ রয়েছে। অনুগ্রহ করে মূল নথির সাথে যাচাই করুন।
